exposure: Cause of preterm delivery (spontaneous vs. indicated)
outcome: Frequency of Ureaplasma-positive gastric fluid cultures
cohort: 464 women with a singleton pregnancy who delivered prematurely (between 23(+0) and 32(+0) weeks of gestation)
finding: Ureaplasma spp. was detected in 20.3% of the GF samples, with a significantly higher frequency in the spontaneous preterm birth group and the vaginal delivery group.
mod_finding: Ureaplasma spp. was more frequently found in the vaginal delivery group than in the cesarean delivery group
